identity: Graphic IV by Paul Goldstaub, alto saxophone and celeste
findings: Dorn catalog identifies Graphic IV, DP502, for alto saxophone and celeste; catalog title Graphics IV and piano accompaniment conflict.
Tom Bergeron's multiphonics bibliography dates its entry 1981 and identifies Dorn; this alone does not distinguish composition from publication date.
Matt Swallow's performer research reproduces an excerpt showing timbre trills with fingering diagrams.
score_observations: Figure 4 on PDF page 7 shows sustained saxophone tones carrying long trill indications and explicit alternative fingering diagrams above the staff.

The excerpt visibly uses changing fingerings for color on sustained pitches, mixed accidentals and multiple dynamic levels. This supports timbral-control demands; complete range and form cannot be inferred from this short excerpt.
